FINAL SUBMISSION CANDIDATE — answer text (concise, no invented integer):

"DE analysis was executed on data/count.csv (21,884 mouse genes, Ensembl IDs, raw integer counts; KL=KD vs WL=control, n=3 vs 3) with a DESeq2-style pipeline (median-of-ratios normalization, dispersion trend fit + MAP shrinkage, negative-binomial GLM Wald test, normal-prior LFC shrinkage; simulation-validated type-I error 3.4-5.5%). Result: 1,779 significant DEGs at p<0.05, |shrunken log2FC|>1, baseMean>10 (986 up / 793 down in KD); variant filters give 1,748 (padj<0.05) and 2,153 (raw LFC). However, the requested gseapy + KEGG_2019_Mouse enrichment could not be executed in the analysis sandbox: there is no network access (gseapy cannot be installed and KEGG_2019_Mouse cannot be downloaded from Enrichr), no R/DESeq2, and no offline Ensembl-to-symbol annotation — which is required because KEGG_2019_Mouse terms use gene symbols while the count matrix uses Ensembl IDs. Therefore the exact integer number of DEGs contributing to the 'Glutathione metabolism' term could not be determined here and is not invented. Defended envelope: with 1,779 DEGs among 21,884 genes, the expected overlap for a ~50-60-gene glutathione set under the null is ~4; an enrichr-style Fisher test (N=21,884) would call the term significantly enriched only at overlap >=8 (>=10 for the raw-LFC variant). Overlaps computed in the offline fallback were 0 — annotation artifacts and lower bounds, not biology."

Payload: executed_analysis = true (DE part executed; enrichment part executed in fallback form and documented as such). Artifacts: work/analysis.py (self-contained, executed), plus retained evidence work/deseq2_style_results.csv, work/DEGs_primary.csv, work/run_log.txt.

differential_expression.method: pure-Python DESeq2-style reimplementation (offline; no R/DESeq2/PyDESeq2 available): median-of-ratios size factors, MoM dispersion + trend fit + log-MAP shrinkage, NB GLM Wald test, normal-prior LFC shrinkage (sigma=0.602, data-driven)

enrichment.fallback_details: offline enrichr-style ORA vs embedded mmu00480 reconstruction (50 symbols, provenance-commented constant); Ensembl->symbol mapping unavailable offline
enrichment.overlap_interpretation: lower bounds due to unmapped genes; not the answer

deviations_from_brief: gseapy not installed/runnable (no network, verified twice incl. explicit --proxy)
KEGG_2019_Mouse not downloadable (Enrichr unreachable; no local copy)
DESeq2 replaced by validated pure-Python reimplementation
apeglm replaced by DESeq2-normal-style prior MAP shrinkage
no final integer for the glutathione overlap; envelope + thresholds reported instead
